source.name: Colorado Rapids: 'Colorado Rapids and UCHealth launch health-focused initiative as part of multi-year jersey rights deal'
source.quote: a multi-year partnership that will see the Colorado-based health system become the Rapids’ official jersey sponsor through the 2029 Major League Soccer season
source.note: SportsPro (15 November 2022) reported it as a seven-year deal; neither the club nor SportsPro reports a value.

note: Front-of-jersey deal announced 14 November 2022, running through the 2029 MLS season. The club page states UCHealth's logo appears on the front of all Rapids First Team match jerseys.
